_comment: INCR-ET profiling config -- per-purpose config for profiling INCR_Reopt_10 execution time across the task-count axis. Drives the pipeline (run_simulation_and_plot_figures.sh) to simulate the single INCR_Reopt_10 scheduler at every N in num_tasks_for_cross_task_comparison, with enable_execution_time_profiling=true so per-interval scheduler execution time is exported alongside the SP metric. Purpose: the INCR-ET scaling curve (how the incremental optimizer's per-activation cost grows with task count), NOT the cross-scheduler comparison or the north-star gates -- for those use paper_simulation_config.json (the single config; P2.8 folded the eval_* keys in so the gate eval reads it too). Use: MODE=prod CONFIG_JSON=simulation_experiments/configs/incr_et_profiling.json ./scripts/run_simulation_and_plot_figures.sh. KNOWN ISSUE (P2.8, deferred -- behavior-affecting, out of scope for the rename): prod_mode is a verbatim copy of the former gate-eval prod block (full 10-scheduler gate set + eval_* keys + run_name_prefix='evalsuite'), NOT the INCR_Reopt_10-only profiling sweep the test_mode and this _comment describe. Fixing the prod_mode VALUES is a result-changing edit and was NOT done in the P2.8 rename pass; resolve separately before any prod INCR-ET profiling run.
_comment_on_naming: All keys use full descriptive names, mirroring paper_simulation_config.json. Times are in seconds unless noted. (test_mode carries eval_* keys that are residue of the copy-paste noted in _comment; they are ignored by the pipeline and only read if this config is pointed at evaluation_suite.py.)

test_mode._comment: Fast smoke: 1 taskset, 70s (>= 2x max hyper-period 66s), N={4,8,10} so every gate has data, all ten schedulers (incl. the five INCR_Reopt_X period arms E3 checks at every N). Validates that the suite runs end-to-end and produces a verdict before launching the ~30-40-min prod run.

prod_mode._comment: Full gate run: 5 tasksets per task count, N={4,6,8,10}, 600s @ interval 10s (~60 scheduling triggers per run). base_random_seed=1000 so tasksets are deterministic and comparable across schedulers. N=4/6/8 are the SP-quality gate points (Q1 small-N=4, Q2/Q3 large-N=8); N=10 is the E1 overhead probe; the five INCR_Reopt_X arms run at every N for the E3 period-monotonicity gate (currently FAILs -- the open P1.1 residual; suite exits red by design until P1.1 resolves). parallel_worker_processes=12 (one scheduler per worker within a taskset; schedulers are independent).

plotting._comment: Publication-quality figure styling (same defaults as paper_simulation_config.json). run_name_prefix='evalsuite' namespaces the run root so the suite's figures/data do not collide with prod or paper runs.

analysis._comment: normalize_sp=true with method 'upper_bound' is REQUIRED by the evaluator: it computes normalized SP = raw_SP / ideal_SP in [0,1] (1.0 = all deadlines met perfectly), independent of any scheduler's realized value. enable_resume_from_existing_results=true so a partial gate run can be resumed by re-invoking the same command. on_taskset_config_change='prompt' (the e2e orchestrator runs non-interactively, so a stale taskset triggers regeneration, not a hang).
